data.description:
testing_mode: GREEN

Add a '## Severity Calibration Rubric' section to plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/reviewer-base.md, inserted AFTER the '## Schema Enforcement' section.

Content must include:
- 5+ MINOR-not-IMPORTANT examples (e.g., unused imports, misspellings in non-user-facing strings, redundant blank lines, variable name style, comment formatting)
- Explicit carve-outs including: 'moved/renamed code with all callsites updated → MINOR, not CRITICAL'

Note: The 5+ examples and carve-outs are content requirements validated by human review at commit time (per behavioral testing standard Rule 5, content assertions on LLM instruction files are prohibited). The structural heading is the automated test boundary.

## Files to Modify
- plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/reviewer-base.md (MODIFY)

## Acceptance Criteria
Pre-edit conflict check:
- REPO_ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && ! grep -rq 'Severity Calibration Rubric' "$REPO_ROOT/plugins/dso/docs/" "$REPO_ROOT/plugins/dso/agents/"

After edit:
- REPO_ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)
- grep -q '^## Severity Calibration Rubric' "$REPO_ROOT/plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/reviewer-base.md"
- python3 -c "c=open('$REPO_ROOT/plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/reviewer-base.md').read(); i1=c.find('## Severity Calibration Rubric'); i2=c.find('## Schema Enforcement'); assert i1 > i2 and i1 > 0, f'rubric at {i1}, schema at {i2}'" (rubric appears after schema enforcement)
- bash "$REPO_ROOT/tests/docs/test-reviewer-severity-calibration.sh" (test now PASS — T1's RED test becomes GREEN)
data.title: GREEN: Add ## Severity Calibration Rubric section to reviewer-base.md
